items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1967-05-03
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: 'I used to take him food up there for him.'

ctx.x: Well he just sick. He just sick and just old you know. He just got so he couldn't walk and he burnt himself pretty bad. He was so weak he fell on the stove and just like to burn yourself up and he never did get over with that. I used to, my wife used to send him food up there. I used to take him food up there for him. He'd cook and I'd take him, you know, something to eat and probably everybody around knew him, done that. He was getting a little check to pay his rent and there was different things like that.

So many of them died that way. So many musicians never got a break. That's the truth. And Shade made some records and everything himself. Yeah he did. You think he'd have made a little money out of that and got something coming in.
Oh yeah, well did he. Well I made records and signed a contract and everything. I was supposed to get so much and so much on the record and nearly get a penny.
